Finish the Phrase

I play two bars. You play the next two. Pick a key, press play, and answer in the gap. Then come back to the start and go round again.

What plays

Press play. The count-in is one bar of clicks, then it loops until you stop it.

Two bars of piano, then two bars of space for your answer. It loops: answer, come back to the start, answer again.

The four rules

1Same tempo. The clock never stops.
2Answer in two bars. No more.
3Come back to bar 1 when you’re done.
4Any note is allowed. So is silence.

Stuck? Four ways in

Each one is a full answer you can play along with. Tap it to hear it, then make your own version.

What makes the two bars tick

Melody

D G F♯ G: a few notes, close together.

Rhythm

Hits on 1, 2e, 3, 4. One off-beat makes it move.

Harmony

G/B → B♭. Only the bass moves, B → B♭, a half step down. The top stays.

Form

Two bars that ask a question and wait. Your two bars answer it.

Can’t think of anything? Play one note on beat 1 of bar 3 and hold it. That is an answer.

A wrong note played twice is a choice.

If you can still play it tomorrow morning without looking at anything, it’s yours.

Metronome

On its own, no piano. Uses the tempo above.
